name: orbit
title: Orbit
blurb: Content orbits around a center point with configurable speed and direction.
description: Renders child content that orbits around a center point. Supports clockwise/counter-clockwise rotation, customizable duration and radius, with optional visual path indicator.
use_when: Hero sections, data visualizations, or displays where orbital motion around a focal point creates visual interest.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical contexts where motion might distract or confuse users.
a11y: Pure orbital animation; semantic content and keyboard access depend on child elements.
